objectives.description: Record the fidelity measurement as evidence
objectives.note: index.json entry for libkin_2004_ch3_ch7 confirms word_ratio: 0.0187, combining_mark_checked: true, combining_mark_dropped: true, combining_marks_missing: 167 -- the missing-marks count matches this document's live ledger residual count exactly (167), a direct cross-check between two independently-computed signals. Markdown word count re-verified directly: 2,682 words (wc -w) against a PDF whose PyMuPDF-extracted text is 133,061 words / 694,009 characters -- word_ratio computed as markdown-words/pdf-words matches the recorded 0.0187 to within the expected wc-vs-split() word-counting discrepancy.

objectives.description: Sample and verify anchor words are absent from markdown, not an anchor algorithm failure
objectives.note: Directly grepped 14 representative occurrences (8 anchor_not_found, 2 ambiguous_anchor, 4 of 6 unrecognized_gap) for distinctive PDF-context terms/symbols against the document's single markdown file. 0 matches in every case (grep -c / grep -n), including a corpus-wide check that the symbol '≺' (precedes) does not appear ANYWHERE in this document's markdown at all. One near-miss checked deliberately (a related fragment 'mso-tp' appears 3 times corpus-wide) to confirm the negative results are not an artifact of over-strict search terms -- the partial match exists but not at the relevant location, consistent with a condensed-paraphrase document that retains SOME but not all of the source vocabulary.

objectives.description: Determine the exact category split of all 167 entries and confirm fidelity covers each
objectives.note: 159 anchor_not_found, 2 ambiguous_anchor, 6 unrecognized_gap = 167 total (matches the plan's estimated split of '159 anchor_not_found, 6 unrecognized_gap, and the ~2 remainder' exactly). All three categories sampled (objective 2) and all confirmed the same root cause -- no category required a different explanation.

objectives.description: Write per-occurrence justifications citing pdf_file + pdf_char_offset + the fidelity measurement
objectives.note: 167 entries written, each retaining its original pdf_file/pdf_char_offset/base_char/context/reason plus a `justification` field (the shared fidelity-gap explanation, citing the word_ratio measurement and cross-checked combining_marks_missing count) and a `verification` field (either the specific grep-verified term for the 14 directly-sampled entries, or a note that the entry is covered by the document-wide measurement and the representative sample for the remaining 153).
